title: 791. Preimage Size of Factorial Zeroes Function

examples.explanation: Values 0 through 4 have zero trailing zeroes.
The zero count skips from 4 to 6.
Values 15 through 19 each give three zeroes.

hints: Trailing zeroes of x! equal floor(x/5) + floor(x/25) + floor(x/125) + ... .
That count function is monotone, so binary-search the smallest x reaching at least k.
If that x yields exactly k, a full block of five consecutive values shares it; otherwise the answer is 0.
